situations: Netflix asked if I'm still watching

justifications.argument: Your Honor, we find ourselves at a crossroads of human necessity and culinary excellence. My client — pizza — has been unjustly doubted at {{time}} on the grounds of '{{situation}}'. The defense submits that this is, in fact, the ideal moment for {{pizza}}. Precedent (Italy v. Everyone, 1889) establishes that pizza is appropriate at all hours. We rest.
justifications.quote: Pizza is not a want. It is a need.

justifications.argument: Let the record show: at {{time}}, with '{{situation}}' as the prevailing condition, the consumption of {{pizza}} pizza is not only justified — it is constitutionally protected. Article 1, Section Pi: 'No citizen shall be denied the right to melted cheese under conditions of emotional complexity.' Case closed.

We present Exhibit A: it is {{time}}. Exhibit B: you are dealing with '{{situation}}'. Exhibit C: {{pizza}} pizza exists and is available to you. The logical conclusion, supported by 94.7% of surveyed Italian grandmothers, is that you must eat the pizza. To deny this would be to deny science itself.
justifications.quote: The crust is the foundation. Of everything.
justifications.authority: Nonna's Supreme Court of Comfort Food

justifications.argument: Distinguished jury, consider this: humans have been eating pizza since roughly 997 AD. In all that time, no one has ever looked back and said 'I regret eating that pizza at {{time}} while {{situation}}.' We have {{pizza}} pizza. We have a moment. We have a destiny. The verdict writes itself.
justifications.quote: Regret is for people who skipped pizza.
justifications.authority: The Historical Society of Good Decisions

justifications.argument: My client respectfully argues that {{time}} is, statistically, the most underrated time for {{pizza}} pizza. Furthermore, '{{situation}}' represents a recognized trigger event under Clause 7 of the Snack Emergency Act. The prosecution's claim that 'it's too late/early' has been dismissed in 47 jurisdictions. Eat the pizza.
justifications.quote: Time is a social construct. Pizza is real.
justifications.authority: Professor O. Mozzarella, Temporal Food Studies
